notes: P2pd2_math_stats (October): main shifted run OK (ATE +0.000149, SE 0.000226) but its k=2 horizon is exactly 0 (n=4,025) and the auxiliary effects=2 run fails inside DIDmultiplegtDYN ('infinite or missing values in x'), so predate.p_joint_shifted is not computable for that cell; the October math becoming panel is the smallest (1,795 relations, 35 first ties vs 2,183/58 on 2026-08-28). Recorded, not patched.

Frozen data/predate_p1_2026-08-30/control/P1_fnfix_math_stats.json was produced from the ECON frame (file=p1_frame_econ.csv, rows_raw=118,393): the producing heredoc used `declare -A`, which /bin/bash 3.2 does not support, so every field resolved to the last label. The October control uses the math frame (19,910 raw rows) and is EQUAL to its gold.

The frozen P3pos_s0_<field>.json controls carry label P3pos_s0_<field>; compare_json compares `label`, so the October shift-0 control runs under the gold's own label P3cut_pos_<field> (as analysis/run_all.sh does) and is strictly EQUAL. The shifted cells keep the paper-facing name P3pos_s2_<field>.json.

afar_cut_grid.csv: same columns as the frozen 2026-08-30 grid; `cut` is the full-precision cut for every row (the frozen grid left p75 empty and pinned med via PIN_CANON), and se_event_pp is the event-clustered SE (the frozen grid printed 0 there because its dig('se_ev') never matched a key). The ledger reads cut_spec/cut/pairs/ate_pp/se_pair_pp only.

analysis/robustness/predate/run_all_predate.sh: one permitted edit (SAR_PREDATE_OUTDIR override, default unchanged; the MANIFEST root follows it) -> its REPO_AUTHORED pin in tests/test_verbatim_pipeline.py is stale until `tools/repin.sh` is run (tests not edited here).
Not run here (cloud cells, pipeline/aws/cal2026-10): P3pd2_econ_full / P3pd2_chemistry_full and their shift-0 controls. Not regenerated here: data/cal2026-10/MANIFEST.sha256 (integration step).

Chemistry and mathematics pos frames are unchanged by the October caliber (D2 removes network-only persons, never Panel 3 pairs), so P3cut_pos_* and P3pos_s2_* for those two fields reproduce the frozen 2026-08-30 numbers exactly; econ pos moved (88,176 -> 90,325 pairs, 108 -> 111 events).
